_doc: Stage E skill tree (data-driven). Each node: branch, tier (1-4, matches danger tiers I-IV; cost follows tier: 1/1/2/3), column (0-2 inside its branch), requires (all of) / any (one of), optional hatch gate (Lineage: highest falcon tier hatched). Descriptions use {param} placeholders filled from SkillEffects constants, so a tooltip can't drift from the code that applies it. Every node has a /qftest check in SkillTreeTests (skill_nodes_live fails if one is missing).

nodes.name: Kinship
nodes.desc: Bond with your falcons grows {bond_gain_pct}% faster

nodes.name: Hardy Wings
nodes.desc: Your falcons within {sync_range} blocks get +{falcon_hp} max health

nodes.name: Tailwind
nodes.desc: Speed I for you while one of your falcons is within {near} blocks

nodes.name: Endurance Flight
nodes.desc: Your falcons' flight stamina drains {stamina_pct}% slower and active abilities cost half stamina

nodes.name: Soul Bond
nodes.desc: A falcon of yours that would die is saved at {soul_pct}% health (once every {soul_min} minutes)

nodes.name: Talon Training
nodes.desc: Your falcons deal {talons_pct}% more damage

nodes.name: Devastating Dive
nodes.desc: Dive Strike hits for {dive_skilled} instead of {dive_base}

nodes.name: Pack Strike
nodes.desc: Your melee hits deal {pack_pct}% more to a target your falcon hit in the last {pack_sec} s

nodes.name: Razor Talons
nodes.desc: Your falcons' hits poison the target for {razor_sec} s

nodes.name: Killing Blow
nodes.desc: Your falcons deal {execute_mult}x damage to targets below {execute_pct}% health

nodes.name: Quantum Focus
nodes.desc: Falcon ability cooldowns are {focus_pct}% shorter

nodes.name: Quantum Sight
nodes.desc: Your falcons' passive abilities reach {sight_mult}x as far

nodes.name: Entangled Ward
nodes.desc: You take {ward_pct}% less damage while one of your falcons is within {near} blocks

nodes.name: Phase Step
nodes.desc: {phase_pct}% chance to phase through a melee hit while one of your falcons is within {near} blocks

nodes.name: Rift Mend
nodes.desc: Dropping below {mend_pct}% health heals you {mend_hp} health from a falcon within {near} blocks (every {mend_sec} s)

nodes.name: Warm Nest
nodes.desc: Eggs within {warmth_range} blocks of you incubate {warmth_mult}x faster

nodes.name: Imprinting
nodes.desc: Falcons that hatch from your eggs start at bond {imprint_bond}

nodes.name: Strong Brood
nodes.desc: Hatchlings from your eggs grow up twice as fast

nodes.name: Legacy
nodes.desc: Hatchlings from your eggs are born with +{legacy_hp} max health

nodes.name: Retriever
nodes.desc: With a falcon of yours within {near} blocks, dropped items within {magnet_range} blocks fly to you

nodes.name: Featherfall
nodes.desc: {fall_pct}% less fall damage while one of your falcons is within {near} blocks

nodes.name: Falcon Scout
nodes.desc: Your falcon marks hostiles within {scout_range} blocks of you (Glowing)
